result.title: Scene-Designer: Learning Design Intelligence for Agentic 3D Scene Generation
result.summary: Generating complete, coherent, and usable 3D indoor scenes from natural language requires strong \textbf{design intelligence}: the ability to design high-quality scenes and critique their quality. However, existing approaches either rely on general-purpose models lacking domain-specific design experience or learn from static scenes. In this work, we introduce \textbf{Scene-Designer}, an agentic framework that learns design intelligence through complementary design and critique experiences. We construct two datasets: \textbf{Scene-OTA-35K}, which provides Observation--Thought--Action supervision for learning scene design and efficient error correction, and \textbf{Scene-OTC-15K}, which provides Observation--Thought--Critic supervision for learning scene quality critique across physical validity, functional correctness, and layout coherence. Based on these experiences, we propose \textbf{Scene-GRPO}, a Critic-guided GRPO framework that improves design decisions and reduces unnecessary trial-and-error corrections. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Scene-Designer achieves superior performance in physical validity, functional correctness, and layout coherence, while the learned Scene-Critic significantly outperforms general-purpose models in scene critique. Moreover, test-time Critic guidance further improves scene generation, showing that the Critic can provide useful guidance beyond training. Additional analysis suggests a trend of mutual enhancement between scene design and critique abilities.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Scene-Designer，一个通过「设计」与「批评」两类经验学习设计智能的 agentic 3D 室内场景生成框架：构建提供 Observation–Thought–Action 与 Observation–Thought–Critic 监督的两个数据集，并提出 Critic 引导的 GRPO 训练方法。
AI.relevance_reason: 其把「生成」与「独立 critic」分离、并在测试时用 critic 引导以减少试错的机制，可能为 LVR 中答案验证、停止决策与训练贡献分配提供可核查的借鉴线索；但研究对象是 3D 场景生成，与 latent 视觉推理状态无直接关系，需进一步判断可迁移性。
